result.instructions: Tools for AFAS Software, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which connectors does our AFAS environment expose?"; "Show the 20 most recent financial entries for the current year."; "List the fields of the Profit_Article connector before I filter it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AFAS Software data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run afas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run afas_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run afas_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. afas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: afas_get_metainfo
tools.title: List connectors
tools.description: List the GetConnectors and UpdateConnectors that the customer's AFAS app connector activates. Use it first to learn which connector names exist. Also checks that the environment and token work. AFAS: GET /profitrestservices/metainfo.

tools.name: afas_get_connector_meta
tools.title: Get connector fields
tools.description: Get the field list of one GetConnector: field names, types and lengths. Use it before filtering or sorting. AFAS: GET /profitrestservices/metainfo/get/{connector}.

connector.description: The GetConnector name, e.g. Profit_Article (from afas_get_metainfo).

tools.name: afas_get_connector
tools.title: Read a connector
tools.description: Read records from one GetConnector, with optional filters (combined with AND), sorting and paging. Returns { skip, take, rows }. Without take, AFAS returns 100 rows. Page with skip and take. AFAS: GET /profitrestservices/connectors/{connector}.

connector.description: The GetConnector name, e.g. Profit_Article (from afas_get_metainfo).

value.description: Value to compare with. Commas and semicolons are not allowed in a value.

operator_type.description: Operator: 1 equals, 2 greater or equal, 3 smaller or equal, 4 greater, 5 smaller, 6 contains, 7 not equal, 8 is empty, 9 not empty, 10 starts with, 11 does not contain, 12 does not start with, 13 ends with, 14 does not end with, 15 quick filter.

order_by.description: Field ids to sort on. Prefix a field with '-' for descending order.

skip.description: Records to skip (default 0). Set skip and take to -1 to return all rows; AFAS fair use applies to large reads.

take.description: Records to return (default 100). Set skip and take to -1 to return all rows.
